input.prompt: Cinematic photograph, Christmas Eve evening in Helsinki, light snow falling, blue hour. A small cozy Finnish neighbourhood cafe with a wooden storefront and a hand-painted sign reading "Kahvila Aurora". The cafe is dark inside, the door is locked, and a small handwritten paper note on the glass reads "Suljettu". In the foreground, over the shoulder of a person in a winter coat and knitted hat, a smartphone screen shows a simple, generic map app card: "Kahvila Aurora" and a green label "Open now · until 18:00". Warm street lights, footprints in fresh snow, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, 35mm film look.
